sloka: तच्छूलं राघवो दृष्ट्वा ज्वलन्तं घोरदर्शनम् ।ससर्ज विशिखान् रामश्चापमायम्य वीर्यवान् ।। ६.१०४.२२ ।।
transliteration: tacchūlaṁ rāghavo dṛṣṭvā jvalantaṁ ghoradarśanam ।sasarja viśikhān rāmaścāpamāyamya vīryavān ।। 6.104.22 ।।

translations.english: Valiant Raghava, seeing the glowing trident that was horrible to look at, loosed a number of arrows at it.
